quarterly_data.quarter: AstraZeneca press release: Alexion advances pioneering leadership in gMG care with (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Alexion will have 15 presentations in generalised myasthenia gravis (gMG) at the AANEM Annual Meeting and MGFA Scientific Session (29 September to 2 October 2026), led by new 52-week open-label extension data from the PREVAIL Phase III trial of gefurulimab. Patients on gefurulimab maintained clinical improvements through the extension (least squares mean, 95% CI: MG-ADL -5.3 (-5.8, -4.8); QMG -5.3 (-6.0, -4.6); MGC -9.4 (-10.3, -8.5)); patients who switched from placebo at week 26 improved from the first assessments and sustained it through week 52 (MG-ADL -4.9 (-5.4, -4.4); QMG -4.6 (-5.4, -3.9); MGC -8.3 (-9.2, -7.3)). Gefurulimab was well-tolerated and no meningococcal infections were reported. A separate PREVAIL analysis to be presented shows reduced risks of gMG-related hospitalisations and rescue therapy use with gefurulimab at week 26 versus placebo.
